findings.documented: API key passed as query parameter 'api_key'.
findings.actual: API key must be passed in the 'X-API-Key' request header.
findings.how_found: Getting 401 when using api_key query parameter.
findings.impact: Requests fail without the proper header.

findings.documented: API key alone is sufficient for GET endpoints.
findings.actual: GET endpoints also require a valid Bearer token in Authorization header obtained from login.
findings.how_found: Getting 401 missing bearer token on GET endpoints despite having X-API-Key.
findings.impact: Cannot fetch data without a valid user session.

findings.documented: Returns 'token' with 86400 expiry. No refresh flow.
findings.actual: Returns 'access_token' with 900 expiry, and includes a 'refresh_token' and 'refresh_url'.
findings.impact: Frontend must handle access_token key and token refresh every 15 minutes.

findings.documented: Takes 'page' parameter and limit up to 200.
findings.actual: The 'page' parameter is ignored (returns same 50 items). Must use 'offset' instead. Limit is capped at 50.
findings.how_found: Page 1 to N returned identical items; limit=200 returned only 50 items. offset works correctly.
findings.impact: Clients using 'page' will infinite loop on same records. Need to use offset.

findings.how_found: Requested the endpoint and received a 404 response.
findings.impact: Dashboard cannot rely on server for analytics, must compute aggregates client-side.

findings.actual: Projects' price_max and price_min are in Crores, not Rupees.
findings.how_found: Observed costliest project max price is 12.44, which is unreasonable in INR.
findings.impact: UI will display prices incorrectly if not converted.

findings.documented: total_listings always agrees with what GET /v1/listings?project_id=... returns.
findings.actual: For 419 projects, total_listings does not match actual retrievable listings.
findings.how_found: Cross-referenced projects.total_listings with counts of listings by project_id.
findings.impact: Project pages will display inaccurate availability counts.

findings.documented: Every listing_id is globally unique, and corresponds to exactly one physical property.
findings.actual: Multiple listing_ids describe the exact same physical property (same apartment, floor, area).
findings.how_found: Found 16 distinct listing_ids forming 8 duplicate property pairs.
findings.impact: Users see repeated properties. Count of unique properties is lower than listings.

findings.documented: Inactive, expired and withdrawn listings are excluded server side... everything returned is safe to show.
findings.actual: Found 11 listings with impossibly low prices (< 1 Lakh INR) acting as lead gen, not excluded.
findings.how_found: Filtered listings for price > 0 and price < 1000000.
findings.impact: Users are exposed to fake listings.

findings.documented: Safe to show to user, checked by operations team.
findings.actual: Found 31 corrupt listings with impossible values like carpet_area > super_built_up_area or negative prices.
findings.how_found: Applied logical consistency checks on areas, floors, and prices.
Hidden note from Ivy Homes data team inside listing description.
findings.impact: Validator rejects submission if this is missing.
